scenario.title: 旅行回來，跟同事朋友分享
scenario.context: 第五章的收尾：旅行回來分享見聞。說故事時會用到過去完成式（在那之前早就…）、推測過去（一定是…）、後悔（早知道就…），還會用上這一章的比較、被動和分詞構句。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Amazing, mostly. It was the trip of a lifetime. I'd been wanting to go for years.
lines.zh: 大部分都很棒，是一生難忘的旅行。我好幾年前就一直想去了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I got food poisoning on day three. I shouldn't have eaten the beach seafood.
lines.zh: 我第三天食物中毒了。我不該吃海灘的海鮮。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Ouch. It must have been awful.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It was. But by the time we got to Chiang Mai, I had recovered.
lines.zh: 是啊。但等我們到清邁的時候，我已經好了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Totally. It's half as crowded as Bangkok and twice as relaxing.
lines.zh: 絕對值得。人潮只有曼谷的一半，放鬆程度是兩倍。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: This is the night market. Walking through it, you can smell grilled pork everywhere.
lines.zh: 這是夜市。走在裡面，到處都聞得到烤豬肉的味道。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Wat Chedi Luang. Built in the 14th century, it was partly destroyed by an earthquake.
lines.zh: 契迪龍寺。它建於十四世紀，有部分被地震摧毀。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: In a heartbeat. It's crossed off my bucket list, but I'd go again. Things like this only happen once in a blue moon.
lines.zh: 毫不猶豫。這已經從我的遺願清單上劃掉了，但我會再去。這種體驗千載難逢。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Sounds like you really lived it up.

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I did. Expensive, but worth every penny.
lines.zh: 是啊。很貴，但每一分錢都值得。

patterns.en: It was the trip of a lifetime.
I'd been wanting to go for years.
It's much cheaper than I expected.
I'd go back in a heartbeat.
Here's a little something I brought back for you.
patterns.zh: 這是我帶回來給你的小東西。

chinglish.wrong: I went to Thailand play for one week.
chinglish.right: I spent a week in Thailand.
chinglish.why: 「去泰國玩」的「玩」不要翻成 play（複習第 39 單元）。

chinglish.wrong: This is a souvenir I bring back for you.
chinglish.right: I brought this back for you.
chinglish.why: 已經帶回來了，用過去式 brought。「伴手禮」可以不用特別說 souvenir。

chinglish.wrong: When I arrived Chiang Mai, I already recovered.
chinglish.right: By the time I arrived in Chiang Mai, I had recovered.
chinglish.why: arrive 後面要加 in / at；先發生的「康復」用過去完成式（複習第 32 單元）。

chinglish.wrong: Thailand is more cheaper than Japan.
chinglish.right: Thailand is much cheaper than Japan.
chinglish.why: 複習第 33 單元：cheaper 不加 more。

grammar.title: 過去完成、推測、should have
grammar.oneLiner: 說旅行故事的三個工具：had + p.p.（更早之前）、must / might have + p.p.（推測）、should have + p.p.（後悔）。
whenToUse: 過去完成：By the time we got there, the market had closed.
過去完成進行式：I'd been wanting to go for years.（到那時為止一直…）
推測過去：It must have been awful. / They might have closed early.
後悔：I should have stayed longer. / I shouldn't have eaten that.
這一章其他工具：twice as… as（比較）、got stolen（被動）、Walking through…（分詞構句）、If I went again, I'd…（type 2）。
所有「情態動詞 + have + p.p.」都是在講過去，差別只在語氣：must（確定）、might（可能）、should（後悔）、could（本來可以）。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 這一章的文法都在處理同一件事：中文的「早就」「一定是」「早知道」都只是加副詞，動詞不變；英文則要把時間線疊到動詞上（had + p.p.、have + p.p.）。說一個旅行故事時，這些結構會密集出現，最容易亂掉。整合單元讓你在同一段故事中練習切換。

examples.correct: When we got to the temple, it had already closed.
examples.incorrect: When we got to the temple, it already closed.

examples.correct: The driver must have taken a wrong turn.
examples.incorrect: The driver must took a wrong turn.

examples.correct: We should have booked the hotel earlier.
Having seen the sunset from the mountain, I'll never forget it.
The tickets were twice as expensive as last year.

quiz.question: By the time we arrived, the ferry ___.
The restaurant was closed. It ___ closed for the holiday.
We ___ have brought more cash. Nobody took cards. (後悔)
If I ___ back, I'd stay a whole month.
I'd ___ wanting to visit Chiang Mai for years before I finally went.
quiz.explanation: had been wanting：到那時為止一直想。

slang.usage: 形容很少發生的事。blue moon 指一個月內出現的第二次滿月。

examples.en: I only take a vacation once in a blue moon.
My brother calls once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 我哥難得才打一次電話。

slang.meaning: 遺願清單、人生必做清單
slang.usage: 這輩子想完成的事的清單。cross something off my bucket list = 完成清單上的一件事。

examples.en: Seeing the northern lights is on my bucket list.
examples.zh: 看極光在我的人生清單上。

examples.en: I finally crossed Japan off my bucket list.
examples.zh: 我終於把日本從清單上劃掉了。

examples.en: We lived it up in Bangkok for a week.
examples.zh: 我們在曼谷盡情玩了一週。

examples.en: You only turn thirty once. Live it up!
examples.zh: 人生只有一次三十歲，好好享受吧！

slang.usage: 形容雖然貴，但完全值得。

examples.en: The hotel was pricey, but it was worth every penny.
examples.zh: 飯店很貴，但每一分錢都值得。

examples.en: This chair was expensive, but my back says it's worth every penny.
examples.zh: 這張椅子很貴，但我的背說完全值得。

review.question: I ___ packed so many clothes. I didn't wear half of them.
review.explanation: 複習第 49 單元：後悔做了。

review.question: Hotels in Bangkok are about half the ___ of hotels in Tokyo.
review.explanation: 複習第 48 單元：half the price。

review.question: ___ in 1296, the city is full of history.
review.explanation: 複習第 47 單元：被動分詞。

review.question: My charger is gone. I ___ left it at the hotel.
review.explanation: 複習第 46 單元：推測過去。

review.question: If I ___ (have) more time off, I'd travel more.
Which is correct?
options: I recommend you to visit in November.
I recommend to visit you in November.

review.question: There ___ to be a problem with my booking.
review.explanation: 複習第 43 單元：There seems to be。

review.question: I'd rather ___ by train than fly.
review.explanation: 複習第 34 單元：would rather + 原形。

review.question: My wallet ___ on the night train.
review.explanation: 複習第 18 單元：be + p.p. 和 get + p.p. 都可以表示被動。

review.question: It was expensive, but it was worth every ___.
review.explanation: worth every penny = 每一分錢都值得。
